inspectedCandidate.note: Explicit reconciliation of original F02 business destinations and private Session action controls. Product-contract preparation, not final C/T, installed acceptance or LIVE proof.

obligations.title: Two distinct Microsoft accounts enter the same installed Team with their own authority
obligations.detail: Requires integrated private Session admission and HTTP. Two original Microsoft principals read their own owner-bound namespace in the same Team. Requester creates exactly one random fixture and rereads it; holder's create is refused401 while its full original Session inventory is unchanged and still readable. Both fixture IDs are absent after original cleanup. Distinct identities, empty destinations or cross-principal denials alone never pass. In addition, both the UI F02 and independent reread must carry distinct original destination/page/canRead/allowedActionIds projections, stable through both actor reloads. Ordering, principal, revisions and availability alone never satisfy this difference.

obligations.title: An explicit A B A Team switch leaves the sibling window on its own Team
obligations.detail: Requires the observed #654 navigation contract in the actual installed C: original action F02 A/B/A, sibling A unchanged and preserved by reload.

obligations.title: An authenticated account without Team access cannot open the original business chapter
obligations.detail: Requires the authenticated no-teams/revoked projection from integrated295eb: identify the original denied principal, preserve absent business owner/data, and observe the original Team business route403.

obligations.title: A foreign installation deep link and reload cannot inherit the current Team selection
obligations.detail: Requires #654 integrated: original valid deep link/reload; foreign installation rejected as invalid before a Team context request; selection/links absent; no fallback.

obligations.title: A Microsoft configuration administrator without Teams cannot acquire business access
obligations.detail: Requires native #661 administration UI in the installed source. The original no-Team Microsoft administrator opens its actual toggle/panel, the UI itself reads the mounted catalog, and rendered rows/actions match. The same actor still receives explicit Team revocation and business403; the native panel remains usable without a Team. API availability alone is insufficient.

obligations.title: Keyboard navigation opens a new Team chat draft on narrow Web without changing owner
obligations.detail: Requires #667 native Chat composed with the real Session facade. At320px, keyboard reaches and opens new Chat; original F02 and the UI Session-list response bind the same owner, the real PromptInputV2 accepts an unsent draft, no Session write occurs, inventory is unchanged and controls remain reachable. No landing or directory/git substitute.

obligations.title: A Team switch keeps a canceled chat draft and discards it only on confirmation
obligations.detail: Requires #667 native draft lifecycle. The actual modal blocks B reads while A's draft is dirty; cancel retains A/URL/text with zero navigation reads. Confirm emits original F02 and Session-list reads for B and discards text. Returning to A never resurrects it. Both Team Session inventories remain unchanged; no prompt/model submission.

obligations.title: Real administration revokes a disposable Team and restores its original configuration
obligations.detail: Requires the original admin observer and durable mounted policy plus native #661 panel. Its own disable POST carries the exact opaque CAS. Observe catalog rereads, original F02 revocation and business403 for both actors, unchanged B, real restore and cleanup. Reconcile uncertainty through an original read; never retry a mutation or accept manual status.

obligations.title: Logout invalidates the original Microsoft browser context and preserves the other account
obligations.detail: Original UI POST204, original F02 unauthenticated401 and stale window reload, with holder authority preserved. Raw token replay/global sign-out/restart remain AZ02 obligations.
